The '''ruby circlet''' is a piece of [[jewelry]] that makes the wearer immune to fire. Worn in the head slot, it gives permanent {{MCW|Fire Resistance}}, which makes it a natural companion for trips to [[Hell]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
The [[Jeweler]] sells the ruby circlet at Apprentice level for 4 [[Obol]]s and one [[Ruby]]. The trade can be used 999 times.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/2/ruby_circlet.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Effect ===
While worn by a player, the ruby circlet gives Fire Resistance, reapplied every tick for 1 second with no particles. The effect wears off within a second of the circlet being taken off.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/fire_proof.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Armor ===
The ruby circlet is worn in the head slot and takes the place of a helmet. It gives 1 [[armor]] point and no armor toughness or knockback resistance. Like all jewelry, it has no durability, so it never breaks, but it burns in fire or lava when dropped and doesn't keep [[piglin]]s calm as adamant and electrum armor do. See [[Jewelry]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.6-alpha|Jewelry became unbreakable.}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|Now built on a poisonous potato instead of a netherite helmet. It still never breaks, but it burns in fire and lava and no longer counts as piglin-safe armor.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/2/ruby_circlet.json}}</ref>}}
